battle.name: 第一次世界大戰
battle.theater: 北海與英吉利海峽戰區
battle.brief: 1914年7月28日奧匈向塞爾維亞宣戰，第一次世界大戰全面爆發。卡面的1862年英國鐵甲艦開戰時已服役五十二年，旗艦位置早被無畏艦取代，只能退居第二線：它仍在大艦隊序列中任分隊旗艦與後勤艦，並在1916年5月31日的日德戰役中出戰、遭德國戰鬥巡洋艦重炮擊中。

kit.name: 鐵甲艦
kit.history: 木殼外面包了鐵。裝甲第一次比砲更難對付，砲塔的設計從此繞著它轉。

countries: 協約國與同盟國兩大陣營在1914年至1918年對峙。海上主導權在英國皇家海軍：海軍部（Admiralty）掌造艦與兵役政策，大艦隊（Grand Fleet）在斯卡帕灣集結，遠征艦隊分駐英格蘭與法國沿岸，第五戰鬥分隊與巡洋分隊負責北海巡邏與偵察。第一、第二戰鬥巡洋艦分隊、裝甲分隊等由分隊司令與旗艦直接指揮，大艦隊總司令為傑利科，另設西方戰區指揮部處理護航與反潛艦，費舍爾出任該職。德國方面由帝國海軍部統籌，公海艦隊駐威廉港與基爾，威廉二世為最高統帥，貝特曼任宰相，1914年8月後由興登堡與魯登道夫主持陸軍最高統帥部，1916年底起由法爾肯海姆接任。法國由霞飛任陸軍總司令，1917年尼維爾接任，1918年3月26日起由福煦統一指揮西線聯軍；俄羅斯帝國以沙皇尼古拉二世為總司令，1915年9月起由布魯西洛夫實際掌兵。1915年義大利加入協約國，1917年美國參戰，日本則自1914年起攻打青島。中立國如西班牙、瑞士、荷蘭、瑞典、挪威與丹麥維持中立，但封鎖與反封鎖宣戰仍使北歐商運損失慘重。
countriesEn: Two great camps, the Allies and the Central Powers, faced each other from 1914 to 1918. At sea the initiative belonged to the Royal Navy: the Admiralty controlled shipbuilding and manning policy, the Grand Fleet assembled at Scapa Flow, the Home Fleets were stationed off England and the French coast, and the Fifth Battle Squadron together with the cruiser squadrons patrolled and reconnoitred the North Sea. The First and Second Battle Cruiser Squadrons and the armoured squadrons were commanded directly by their squadron commanders and flagships, with Admiral Jellicoe as Commander-in-Chief of the Grand Fleet, while a separate Western Approaches command handled convoys and anti-submarine work, a post taken by Sir John Fisher. On the German side the Reichsmarineamt directed naval affairs and the High Seas Fleet was based at Wilhelmshaven and Kiel; Kaiser Wilhelm II was the supreme commander and Bethmann Hollweg was chancellor, and from August 1914 the Army High Command was run by Hindenburg and Ludendorff, with Falkenhayn taking over at the end of 1916. In France Joffre was commander-in-chief, Nivelle succeeded him in 1917, and from 26 March 1918 Foch assumed unified command of the Allied armies on the Western Front. Russia was commanded by Tsar Nicholas II, with Brusilov taking the practical direction of operations from September 1915. Italy joined the Allies in 1915, the United States entered the war in 1917, and Japan had been fighting since 1914 when it attacked Tsingtao. Neutral states such as Spain, Switzerland, the Netherlands, Sweden, Norway and Denmark tried to stay out, but the blockade and the British blockade war against Germany still left northern European shipping badly hit.
people: 威廉二世是德國的象徵與決策核心，1914年7月對奧匈開出空白支票，8月初批准進攻法國並對英國開戰；貝特曼與魯登道夫在1918年推動春季攻勢，企圖以兵力優勢逼和。德軍西線實際統帥是興登堡與魯登道夫，坦嫩貝格的勝利把他們送上高位，隨後主導凡爾登與索姆河的消耗戰。英國海軍方面，傑利科自1914年12月起任大艦隊總司令，1916年5月31日坐鎮旗艦指揮日德戰役；貝蒂率戰鬥巡洋艦分隊主動接戰，赫德率第三戰鬥巡洋艦分隊，維安以旗艦馬爾波羅號指揮第一戰鬥分隊，阿布思諾特以旗艦防禦號指揮第二戰鬥巡洋艦分隊，卡面的戰士級裝甲艦戰士號亦在此序列。費舍爾主張全面護航與反潛艦攻勢。德國海軍的公海艦隊由謝爾統籌，戰鬥巡洋艦分隊由希佩爾率領；施佩的東亞分艦隊在1914年12月福克蘭海峽戰役全軍覆沒，沙恩霍斯特號與格奈森瑙號擊沉英方好望號與蒙茅斯號。陸軍方面，黑格、拉夫林、尼維爾與1917年後投入西線的潘興所部，以及1915年第二次馬恩河戰役中扭轉戰局的麥肯森，都是左右戰局的人物。
peopleEn: Wilhelm II was the symbol and the decision centre of Germany: he extended the blank cheque to Austria-Hungary in July 1914, approved the march into France in August, and approved the war against Britain. Bethmann Hollweg and Ludendorff drove the spring offensive of 1918 in the hope of forcing a negotiated peace. The real commanders of the German armies in the West were Hindenburg and Ludendorff, whose victory at Tannenberg put them at the top, and who then directed the war of attrition at Verdun and on the Somme. In the British navy, Jellicoe was Commander-in-Chief of the Grand Fleet from December 1914 and sat at the centre of the Battle of Jutland on 31 May 1916; Beatty led the battlecruiser squadron into action, Hood led the Third Battle Cruiser Squadron, Vian commanded the First Battle Squadron from Marlborough, and Arbuthnot commanded the Second Battle Cruiser Squadron from the armoured flagship Defence, in whose company also fought the Warrior-class ironclad of the card. Fisher argued for a full convoy system and for a sustained anti-submarine offensive. On the German side Spee's East Asia Squadron was destroyed in the Falkland battle of December 1914, where Scharnhorst and Gneisenau sank the British Good Hope and Monmouth. The High Seas Fleet was headed by Scheer, while Hipper led the battlecruiser division in its role of intercepting the British fleet. On land the names of Haig, Rawlinson and Nivelle belong to the British and French staffs, Pershing's American Expeditionary Forces joined the Western Front from 1917 to 1918, and Mackensen reversed the situation at the Second Battle of the Marne in 1915.
kits: 卡面的1862年鐵甲艦對應英國皇家海軍戰士級裝甲主力艦：木殼外包鍛鐵裝甲帶，排水量約六千三百八十噸，裝甲厚四英寸半，主炮為二十六門六十八磅滑膛炮，航速約十五節，是史上第一艘以鐵殼加裝甲為設計起點的戰鬥艦。到1914年，這條設計路線已讓位給無畏艦：英國1906年下水的主炮艦確立只留大砲的思路，裝甲與火力配比重新計算，戰士級僅能充當預備、後勤與教練用途。戰役中真正投入的裝備包括英德雙方的無畏艦、戰鬥巡洋艦、裝甲巡洋艦與數百艘驅逐艦；德國1916年後的UB III型潛艇可深航並支援集群作戰，Q船與武裝商船巡洋艦用於破壞航運，水聽器、ASDIC與深水炸彈構成反潛組合，皇家海軍航空隊以水上機與飛艇執行偵察、轟炸與反飛艇攔截。陸戰方面有1916年9月15日首次投入的馬克型戰車、十八磅野戰炮與大口徑榴彈炮、火焰投射器、毒氣，以及仍佔多數的馬匹、鐵路與人力搬運組成的補給鏈。
kitsEn: The ironclad of the card corresponds to the British Royal Navy's Warrior-class armoured capital ship: a wooden hull sheathed with wrought-iron armour belt, about six thousand three hundred and eighty tons of displacement, four and a half inches of armour, a main battery of twenty-six sixty-eight-pounder smoothbore guns, and a speed of roughly fifteen knots; she was the first fighting ship designed from the start around an iron hull with armour. By 1914 that line of design had already given way to the dreadnought: the all-big-gun capital ship laid down in Britain in 1906 settled the argument, the balance of armour and firepower was recalculated, and the Warrior class could serve only as reserve, depot and training hulls. The equipment actually committed to the war included the dreadnoughts, battlecruisers, armoured cruisers and several hundred destroyers of both fleets; the German UB III type submarines of 1916 and later could make deep dives and operate in groups, Q-ships and armed merchant cruisers were used to break up shipping, hydrophones, ASDIC and depth charges formed the anti-submarine combination, and the Royal Naval Air Service used seaplanes and airships for reconnaissance, bombing and airship interception. On land the inventory included the Mark tank first committed on 15 September 1916, eighteen-pounder field guns and heavy howitzers, flamethrowers, poison gas, and a supply chain still carried largely by horses, railways and human muscle.
tactics: 海上戰術在四年中經歷三個階段。1914至1915年以艦隊存在為主：德國公海艦隊避免主力決戰，英軍以遠距封鎖與北海雷區施壓，兩國殘存的裝甲艦改編成的分隊承擔巡邏、封鎖與駐泊任務，1914年8月28日赫利戈蘭海峽與1915年1月24日多格海灘兩役，主力是巡洋艦與戰鬥巡洋艦。1916年5月31日日德戰役把戰術推到頂點：貝蒂的戰鬥巡洋艦分隊以追縱陣位前出，遭德軍主力分隊截擊而折損慘重，暴露裝甲偏薄、轉向吃力的缺陷；主力艦分隊以縱隊與梯次射擊接近，撤退階段由驅逐艦分隊夜襲魚雷，德國塞德利茨號重傷未沉。1917年2月起德國改行無限制潛艇戰，英國以護航制度、護航戰鬥群、Q船偽裝與深水炸彈回應，海上重心由艦對艦轉為船對船的護航與反潛。陸戰方面，1914年密集縱隊衝鋒迅速消耗，1916年後改為步兵接替、逐步射擊與短縱深炮火準備，1917至1918年加上戰車與空軍協同，協約國最終在多條戰線同時發動攻勢。
tacticsEn: Naval tactics passed through three stages in four years. From 1914 to 1915 the fleet-in-being was the central idea: the German High Seas Fleet avoided a decisive action, the British imposed pressure with a distant blockade and minefields in the North Sea, and squadrons improvised from the surviving armoured ships of both countries performed patrols, blockade duty and harbour work, the actions of 28 August 1914 at Heligoland Bight and 24 January 1915 at the Dogger Bank being fought mainly by cruisers and battlecruisers. The Battle of Jutland on 31 May 1916 carried tactical thinking to its peak: Beatty's battlecruisers advanced in line of battle ahead, were intercepted by the German battlecruiser division and lost heavily, exposing their thin armour and poor turning; the battle squadrons closed in line astern with successive divisions firing, and in the withdrawal destroyer flotillas launched night torpedo attacks, while the German Seydlitz was badly damaged but not sunk. From February 1917 Germany turned to unrestricted submarine warfare, and Britain answered with the convoy system, escort groups, Q-ship deception and depth charges, so that the centre of gravity at sea shifted from ship against ship to the escort and anti-submarine war. On land the dense columns of 1914 were consumed in a few weeks, and from 1916 the method became a creeping barrage, a short artillery preparation and infantry in relays, with tanks and aircraft added in 1917 and 1918, until the Allies attacked on several fronts at once.
data: 可核對的數字不少。1914年8月英國遠征軍只有六個師，約八萬五千人，到1918年西線兵力超過一百萬人；德軍首批投入西線的部隊逾一百五十萬人，1918年總兵力增至約五百萬人。兩大陣營累計動員兵力合計逾七千萬人，陣亡軍人約一千萬至一千二百萬人。日德戰役是投入艦艇最多的一次海戰，雙方合計出動艦艇逾一百五十艘，參戰水兵約六萬人；英方折損戰鬥巡洋艦四艘、裝甲主力艦一艘以上（旗艦防禦號沉沒，戰士號重創）、驅逐艦十艘，陣亡約三千人；德方損失輕巡洋艦一艘、驅逐艦五艘、魚雷艇三艘，陣亡、被俘與受傷合計逾七千人。西線戰壕總長約六百五十公里；德國在北海佈雷逾十萬枚；1917年一年內被潛艇擊沉的協約國商船逾二千五百艘、總噸位近一千萬噸；德國可用潛艇由1914年的不足三十艘增至1917年的一百五十艘以上。戰車方面，1916年9月15日首次實戰，至停戰時協約國造出六千輛以上。
dataEn: A number of figures can be checked. In August 1914 the British Expeditionary Force numbered only six divisions, about eighty-five thousand men, and by 1918 its strength on the Western Front exceeded one million, while the German armies committed to the West in the first months numbered more than one and a half million and grew to about five million in 1918. The two camps together mobilised more than seventy million men, of whom something between ten and twelve million were military dead. Jutland was the largest naval engagement ever fought, with more than one hundred and fifty ships committed on both sides and roughly sixty thousand men involved; the British lost four battlecruisers, at least one armoured capital ship with the flagship Defence sunk and the Warrior badly damaged, and ten destroyers, with about three thousand dead, while Germany lost one light cruiser, five destroyers and three torpedo boats, with more than seven thousand dead, wounded or captured. The trench line on the Western Front ran for some six hundred and fifty kilometres; Germany laid more than one hundred thousand mines in the North Sea; in 1917 alone over two thousand five hundred Allied merchant ships, close to ten million gross tons, were sunk by submarines; and the submarines available to Germany grew from fewer than thirty in 1914 to more than one hundred and fifty in 1917. Tanks were first used in action on 15 September 1916, and by the armistice the Allies had built over six thousand of them.
cause: 開戰的直接導火線是塞拉熱窩事件：1914年6月28日，奧匈帝國皇儲弗朗茨·斐迪南在波斯尼亞的塞拉熱窩被塞爾維亞民族主義者普林西普刺殺，奧匈在德國支持下向塞爾維亞發出最後通牒，7月28日宣戰。俄羅斯以斯拉夫民族與泛斯拉夫主義動員全境支持塞爾維亞，7月30日沙皇下令動員，兩個帝國的衝突沿俄奧邊境與巴爾幹擴散。德國把衝突推成列強大戰：向奧匈提供空白支票，8月1日對俄宣戰、8月3日對法宣戰，把小毛奇的速決戰計劃變成現實，右翼主力經比利時迂迴法國。英國因德軍侵犯中立國比利時、且德國在1916年2月宣布對英國船隻無限制攔截，於8月4日宣戰；日本因德軍佔領中國租界於8月23日宣戰。深層原因是帝國主義競爭、海軍軍備競賽與作戰計畫本身，1914年英國海軍大臣的計畫已把摧毀德國海軍列為開戰目標。
causeEn: The immediate spark was the Sarajevo assassinations: on 28 June 1914 the Austro-Hungarian heir Franz Ferdinand was killed by the Serbian nationalist Princip in Sarajevo, and Austria-Hungary, backed by Germany, sent an ultimatum to Serbia and declared war on 28 July. Russia mobilised the whole empire on the grounds of Slav and pan-Slav solidarity with Serbia, the Tsar ordering mobilisation on 30 July, and the clash of the two empires spread along the Russo-Austrian frontier and through the Balkans. Germany turned that clash into a war of the great powers: it gave Austria-Hungary the blank cheque, declared war on Russia on 1 August and on France on 3 August, and turned the Schlieffen plan into reality, the right wing of the German armies swinging through Belgium to outflank France. Britain declared war on 4 August after German troops violated neutral Belgium and after Germany announced in February 1916 that all British shipping would be subject to unrestricted attack; Japan declared war on 23 August after German troops occupied Chinese treaty ports. Beneath these lay imperial rivalry, the naval armaments race and the war plans themselves, for the British naval planners of 1914 already listed the destruction of the German fleet as an object of the war.
impact: 四年戰爭改寫了歐洲的版圖與政治結構。1917年俄羅斯帝國崩解，退出戰事並交出大片東歐土地；德意志帝國、奧匈帝國與鄂圖曼帝國相繼瓦解，1919至1920年間出現奧地利、匈牙利、捷克斯洛伐克、波蘭、南斯拉夫等國家，中東則依英法秘密條約落入托管。海上最深的改變是英國確立對北海的制海權：無限制潛艇戰雖在1917年重創商運，也迫使英國全面推行護航制度，此後國際海事以護航隊而非單艦護航為常態；戰後海軍條約為主力艦噸位與火砲口徑設下上限，裝甲與火力的自由競賽被壓縮，各國把競爭轉向潛艦、航空母艦與遠程火砲。技術層面上，戰車、化學武器、潛艇、飛機、無線電與全國性動員成為二十世紀的常備項目，戰爭的總動員經驗也重塑了各國的經濟政策與軍事編制。
impactEn: Four years of war rewrote the map and the political structure of Europe. The Russian Empire collapsed in 1917, left the war and surrendered vast tracts of eastern Europe; the German, Austro-Hungarian and Ottoman empires fell apart in turn, and between 1919 and 1920 states such as Austria, Hungary, Czechoslovakia, Poland and Yugoslavia came into being, while the Middle East passed into mandates drawn up under the secret British and French agreements. The deepest change at sea was the establishment of British command of the North Sea: although unrestricted submarine warfare wrecked shipping in 1917, it also forced Britain to adopt the convoy system in full, after which international shipping moved in escorted groups rather than under single-ship escort; the naval treaties after the war put limits on the tonnage of capital ships and the calibre of their guns, compressing the free competition in armour and firepower and pushing the race into submarines, aircraft carriers and long-range guns. At the level of technology, tanks, chemical weapons, submarines, aircraft, wireless and national mobilisation became standing features of the twentieth century, and the experience of total war reshaped the economic policies and military establishments of every belligerent.
result: 1918年春，魯登道夫的攻勢在協約國連續反擊與美軍大量抵達之下崩解，協約國自8月起在多條戰線同時推進，德軍在萊茵河與維爾納以東的據點相繼失守，11月初德國代表在貢比涅與協約國簽署停戰協議，11月11日中午槍炮靜默。戰爭以同盟國的失敗告終：德意志帝國解體、奧匈帝國分裂、鄂圖曼帝國被瓜分，協約國接管德國的殖民地並取得國際聯盟的領導席位。海軍方面，德國公海艦隊依停戰條款解除武裝，在威廉港由英美部隊看管，隨後駛往斯卡帕灣被解除武裝拆解；卡面那艘1862年的鐵甲艦在戰後退作後勤與訓練用途，最終在1920年代初拆解。戰爭留下的還有龐大的傷殘兵員與戰俘名單、退役軍人的復原問題，以及凡爾賽和約體系在歐洲造成的長期邊界糾葛。
resultEn: In the spring of 1918 Ludendorff's offensive collapsed under continuous Allied counter-attacks and the arrival of large American forces; from August the Allies advanced on several fronts at once, German positions east of the Rhine and east of the Vistula fell one after another, German delegates signed the armistice at Compiègne in early November, and at noon on 11 November the guns fell silent. The war ended in defeat for the Central Powers: the German Empire broke up, Austria-Hungary was split, the Ottoman Empire was partitioned, and the Allies took over the German colonies and the leading seat in the League of Nations. At sea the German High Seas Fleet was disarmed under the terms of the armistice, was kept under British and American guard at Wilhelmshaven, and later sailed to Scapa Flow to be disarmed and broken up; the ironclad of the card, built in 1862, was relegated after the war to depot and training duties and was finally scrapped in the early 1920s. The war also left an immense list of disabled soldiers and prisoners of war, the problem of settling and employing the demobilised, and the long-running border disputes left behind by the Versailles system in Europe.
